newsitem.title: INDIA: India April sugar output falls to 1.54 mln tonnes.
newsitem.headline: India April sugar output falls to 1.54 mln tonnes.

text.p: India produced 1.54 million tonnes of sugar in April compared with 2.13 million in the same month in 1996, two industry associations said on Sunday.

The Indian Sugar Mills Association and the National Federation of Cooperative Sugar Factories Ltd said in a joint statement that the country produced 12.3 million tonnes of sugar between October 1996 and April 1997 against 13.9 million in the corresponding seven-month period last season.
Sugar despatches from factories in April 1997 stood at 1.1 million tonnes for domestic consumption and 15,000 tonnes for exports.
In April 1996, sugar despatches from factories were 940,000 tonnes for internal consumption and 109,000 tonnes for exports, the statement said.
Sugar stocks on April 30 stood at 11.8 million tonnes compared with 11.4 million on the same date in 1996, the statement said.
